title: Passive & Causative: Stories from School and Work
description: Things that happened to you, things you made others do, and things you were made to do.

points.title: Passive, past
points.summary: Passive & causative: Something is done to you (passive), you make / let someone do it (causative), and you're made to do it (causative-passive).
points.body:
- **Passive**: る-verbs + られる; う-verbs → あ-row + れる (踏まれる); する → される.
- **Causative**: る-verbs + させる; う-verbs → あ-row + せる (書かせる); する → させる.
- **Causative-passive**: る-verbs + させられる; う-verbs → あ-row + される (飲まされる; せられる also works; す-verbs only せられる); する → させられる.
examples: {電車|でんしゃ}の{中|なか}で{足|あし}を踏まれた。
Someone stepped on my foot on the train.

points.title: Passive + ている
points.summary: Passive & causative: Something is done to you (passive), you make / let someone do it (causative), and you're made to do it (causative-passive).
points.body:
- **Passive**: る-verbs + られる; う-verbs → あ-row + れる (踏まれる); する → される.
- **Causative**: る-verbs + させる; う-verbs → あ-row + せる (書かせる); する → させる.
- **Causative-passive**: る-verbs + させられる; う-verbs → あ-row + される (飲まされる; せられる also works; す-verbs only せられる); する → させられる.
examples: この{本|ほん}は{世界中|せかいじゅう}で読まれている。
This book is read all over the world.

points.title: Causative (make / let), past
points.summary: Passive & causative: Something is done to you (passive), you make / let someone do it (causative), and you're made to do it (causative-passive).
points.body:
- **Passive**: る-verbs + られる; う-verbs → あ-row + れる (踏まれる); する → される.
- **Causative**: る-verbs + させる; う-verbs → あ-row + せる (書かせる); する → させる.
- **Causative-passive**: る-verbs + させられる; う-verbs → あ-row + される (飲まされる; せられる also works; す-verbs only せられる); する → させられる.
examples: {母|はは}は{弟|おとうと}に{部屋|へや}を掃除させた。
Mum made my little brother clean his room.

points.title: Causative-passive (was made to), past
points.summary: Passive & causative: Something is done to you (passive), you make / let someone do it (causative), and you're made to do it (causative-passive).
points.body:
- **Passive**: る-verbs + られる; う-verbs → あ-row + れる (踏まれる); する → される.
- **Causative**: る-verbs + させる; う-verbs → あ-row + せる (書かせる); する → させる.
- **Causative-passive**: る-verbs + させられる; う-verbs → あ-row + される (飲まされる; せられる also works; す-verbs only せられる); する → させられる.
examples: {子供|こども}のころ、{毎日|まいにち}ピアノを練習させられた。
As a child I was made to practise the piano every day.

questions.prompt:
{電車|でんしゃ}の{中|なか}で{足|あし}を（　）。
→ {踏|ふ}む · passive, past
questions.explanation: Passive: {踏|ふ}む is an う-verb (godan): む → ま (あ-row) + れる → **踏まれた**.
questions.translation: Someone stepped on my foot on the train.

questions.prompt:
{遅刻|ちこく}して、{先生|せんせい}に（　）。
→ {叱|しか}る · passive, past
questions.explanation: Passive: {叱|しか}る is an う-verb (godan): る → ら (あ-row) + れる → **叱られた**.
questions.translation: I was late and got told off by the teacher.

questions.prompt:
{駅|えき}で{財布|さいふ}を（　）。
→ {盗|ぬす}む · passive, past
questions.explanation: Passive: {盗|ぬす}む is an う-verb (godan): む → ま (あ-row) + れる → **盗まれた**.
questions.translation: My wallet was stolen at the station.

questions.prompt:
このお{寺|てら}は800{年前|ねんまえ}に（　）。
→ {建|た}てる · passive, past
questions.explanation: Passive: {建|た}てる is a る-verb (ichidan): drop る + られる → **建てられた**.
questions.translation: This temple was built 800 years ago.

questions.prompt:
この{本|ほん}は{世界中|せかいじゅう}で（　）。
→ {読|よ}む · passive + ている
questions.explanation: Passive: {読|よ}む is an う-verb (godan): む → ま (あ-row) + れる → **読まれている**.
questions.translation: This book is read all over the world.

questions.prompt:
この{歌|うた}は{今|いま}も{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}に（　）。
→ {歌|うた}う · passive + ている
questions.explanation: Passive: {歌|うた}う is an う-verb (godan): う → わ (あ-row) + れる → **歌われている**.
questions.translation: This song is still sung by many people.

questions.prompt:
{母|はは}は{弟|おとうと}に{部屋|へや}を（　）。
→ {掃除|そうじ}する · causative (make / let), past
questions.explanation: {掃除|そうじ}する is irregular (する): する → させた → **掃除させた**.
questions.translation: Mum made my little brother clean his room.

questions.prompt:
{先生|せんせい}は{学生|がくせい}に{作文|さくぶん}を（　）。
→ {書|か}く · causative (make / let), past
questions.explanation: Causative: {書|か}く is an う-verb (godan): く → か (あ-row) + せる, past → **書かせた**.
questions.translation: The teacher had the students write an essay.

questions.prompt:
{誕生日|たんじょうび}は、{子供|こども}に{好|す}きなものを（　）。
→ {食|た}べる · causative (make / let), past
questions.explanation: Causative: {食|た}べる is a る-verb (ichidan): drop る + させる, past → **食べさせた**.
questions.translation: On their birthday, we let the kids eat whatever they liked.

questions.prompt:
{部長|ぶちょう}は{私|わたし}を{一時間|いちじかん}も（　）。
→ {待|ま}つ · causative (make / let), past
questions.explanation: Causative: {待|ま}つ is an う-verb (godan): つ → た (あ-row) + せる, past → **待たせた**.
questions.translation: My manager kept me waiting for a whole hour.

questions.prompt:
{子供|こども}のころ、{毎日|まいにち}ピアノを（　）。
→ {練習|れんしゅう}する · causative-passive (was made to), past
accept: れんしゅうさせられた
questions.explanation: {練習|れんしゅう}する is irregular (する): する → させられた → **練習させられた**.
questions.translation: As a child I was made to practise the piano every day.

questions.prompt:
{飲|の}み{会|かい}で、{先輩|せんぱい}にお{酒|さけ}を（　）。
→ {飲|の}む · causative-passive (was made to), past
questions.explanation: Causative-passive: {飲|の}む is an う-verb (godan): む → ま (あ-row) + される (short form; せられる also works), past → **飲まされた**.
questions.translation: At the party my senior made me drink.

questions.prompt:
{昨日|きのう}、{駅|えき}で{一時間|いちじかん}も（　）。
→ {待|ま}つ · causative-passive (was made to), past
questions.explanation: Causative-passive: {待|ま}つ is an う-verb (godan): つ → た (あ-row) + される (short form; せられる also works), past → **待たされた**.
questions.translation: Yesterday I was kept waiting at the station for a whole hour.

questions.prompt:
{給食|きゅうしょく}で、{嫌|きら}いな{野菜|やさい}を（　）。
→ {食|た}べる · causative-passive (was made to), past
questions.explanation: Causative-passive: {食|た}べる is a る-verb (ichidan): drop る + させられる, past → **食べさせられた**.
questions.translation: At school lunch I was made to eat vegetables I hated.
